admission.text: “Prepare for grief and depression. Letting go of a dependent relationship can be as painful as going through a divorce.”
admission.source: Emotional Dependency: A Threat to Close Friendships (InterVarsity Press, 1990; first published by Love in Action, 1984, and Exodus International–North America, 1987), printed p. 25 (Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428, Box 2 Folder 9, PDF p. 30), read on the page image

note: In both copies the admission is shown whole, at once, on the plain record panel and held over a quiet chord (fully legible 102.8-112.4 s, 9.6 s); its [1] is burned into the bar; nothing is drawn over the tape in the room.
